paragraphs: R' Natan Kohen, brother of R' Chiya bar Abba.
See the entry R' Kohen. Bereshit Rabbah 6:5 reads “Rabbi Natan, son of the brother of Rabbi Chiya bar Abba”; Hyman says it should read “brother,” omitting “son of.”[^1]

notes.text: פ״ו-ה is read 6:5, not the older 86:5 guess; machine פ״רה differs from supplied פ״ו-ה. The separately read Midrash Rabbah--TE 6:5 has full רבי נתן בר אחוה דרבי חייא בר אבא, supporting Rabbi for both people in that quoted nephew reading only. It later says he addressed his brother; this does not independently adjudicate Hyman’s proposed deletion of bar. The heading’s brother reading and internal Kohen cross-reference are separate occurrences and retain R'. Kohen remains a supplied name/priestly designation, without identity or occupational adjudication; omission in the indexed alias does not delete it.
